answer_1.quote: DiNaM uses an LLM to find patterns of false information in each cluster and generate a matching disinformation narrative.

answer_2.quote: To assess the similarity between the predicted and reference narratives, we used the Weighted Chamfer Distance.

answer_4.quote: Each article was annotated by two independent experts. They reached agreement on 124 articles, which comprise our final evaluation set.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators must carefully review each fact-checking article to determine whether all claims verified in the article are confirmed as false.
